row.answer: Kayle is a marksman/mage whose attacks gain speed, range and magic-damage waves as she levels. Her damage scales with AD and AP, and her ultimate grants temporary invulnerability.
row.counterplay: Pressure her before her ranged upgrades, avoid extended attack trades, and save burst until invulnerability ends.

row.counterplay: Pressure her early and disengage when she builds attack stacks.

row.answer: Starfire Spellblade: Attacks passively deal bonus magic damage.
